cohort: 173 women with spontaneously-conceived twin deliveries at a tertiary-level center over a nine-year period
finding: Neonates delivered by cesarean section had a higher rate of prematurity-associated pathology, NICU admission, lower birth weight, and longer length of stay compared to those delivered vaginally.
